sara: Quick sanity check — our Go streaming client is getting 401 only when running inside the Docker image in GitHub Actions. Works locally. We set up Basic auth using the API key as the username and an empty password. I build the header like this: Authorization: Basic $(echo -n \"$REDWOOD_KEY\" | base64). Dockerfile snippet below and entrypoint does the curl. Getting 401 from hosted API. Any quick ideas?

sara: Dockerfile snippet:
```
ARG REDWOOD_KEY
ENV REDWOOD_KEY=$REDWOOD_KEY
ENTRYPOINT ["/app/entrypoint.sh"]
```
entrypoint excerpt:
```
export AUTH=$(echo -n \"$REDWOOD_KEY\" | base64)
curl -H \"Authorization: Basic $AUTH\" https://api.redwood.example/v1/stream
```

mike: Which runner/shell in GH Actions? can you paste the exact curl header value (masked ok) and show whether header length differs from your local run?

sara: ubuntu-latest, bash. Header prints as Basic <longstring>. Locally length looks a bit different. I can run hexdump/od to see nonprintables.

julia: Two common gotchas here: (1) echo vs echo -n — plain echo adds a trailing \n which becomes part of the base64 and will change the header. (2) Basic auth encoding MUST be base64(\"username:password\"). If your password is empty you still need the colon — so base64(\"API_KEY:\") not base64(\"API_KEY\"). Try: `echo -n \"$REDWOOD_KEY:\" | base64`

chris: Also watch for CRLFs if the secret was copied from Windows or edited in Notepad. GH Actions secrets are masked but not modified by the runner. To inspect bytes: `printf '%s' \"$REDWOOD_KEY\" | od -An -t x1` — look for 0d. To sanitize: `printf '%s' \"$REDWOOD_KEY\" | tr -d '\r' | ...` or `printf '%s' \"$REDWOOD_KEY\" | base64` (with colon)

sara: Tried `echo -n \"$REDWOOD_KEY:\" | base64` and wired it in — stream is authorized now, no more 401. Thanks! It looks like my local helper inserted the trailing colon earlier so I didn't notice.

mike: great. can you add a one-liner to devex quickstart about Basic header construction for streaming (explicitly show `echo -n \"$REDWOOD_KEY:\" | base64`) and a tiny CI check so future GH Actions runs fail fast if header is wrong?

dev-bot: friendly reminder — please link the docs PR in the onboarding checklist. Docs missing the note will block a new hire setup.

sara: on it, opening the PR in 10m with example and the small CI curl check. thanks all.
